# disposition notification to

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:dispositionNotificationTo`](gmeow-dispositionNotificationTo.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/dispositionNotificationTo>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/email`](../../slices/email.md)

The email address to which a read receipt or other message disposition notification should be sent (RFC 3798 Disposition-Notification-To). Non-functional: multiple addresses may be listed.
